content: The use of high-intensity and moderate-intensity statins has been shown to effectively lower LDL cholesterol levels. According to the American Diabetes Association (ADA), for patients who do not achieve their target LDL cholesterol levels with statin therapy alone, the addition of other lipid-lowering agents can provide further benefit. Specifically, combining statins with ezetimibe has been demonstrated to enhance LDL cholesterol reduction. Similarly, the use of PCSK9 inhibitors in conjunction with statins is also effective in achieving additional decreases in LDL cholesterol levels. These combination therapies not only lower LDL cholesterol more effectively but also reduce the associated risks of cardiovascular events.
